Section 1 (R.C. 2923.13): (6) The person is charged with or has been convicted of a violation of section 2919.25 of the Revised Code that is a misdemeanor of the first degree.
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.13): Whoever violates this section is guilty of having weapons while under disability, a felony of the third degree.
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.14): Is automatically void upon commission by the applicant of any offense set forth in division (A)(2), (3), or (6) of section 2923.13 of the Revised Code, or upon the applicant's becoming one of the class of persons named in division (A)(1), (4), or (5) of that section.
